_comment: Where Tuya's own category list (_tuya_categories.json) decides, not HA core's tables. Hand-authored; the categories file is generated.

switch_device_class._comment: HA switch device_class by the standard's category NAME. Only replaces a socket-like class (outlet) that core's table gives a switch description; a description without one, and a category whose name is not listed, stay as core has them.
